questions.q: What is the difference between dictation and voice conversation?
options: Dictation reads answers aloud, while voice conversation types them out
Dictation types your words, while voice conversation is a spoken back-and-forth
Dictation only works with photos, while voice conversation only works with text
There's no difference, since they're two names for the same feature
questions.explain: Dictation turns your speech into text in the message box, which is great for long, rambling context. Voice conversation is a spoken back-and-forth, a bit like a phone call with your assistant.

questions.q: You receive a confusing letter and want AI to explain it from a photo. What's the best approach?
options: Attach the uncropped photo with no question and let the AI decide
Attach it and rely on whatever dates and amounts the AI reads back
Retype the whole letter instead, since AI can never read photos
Cover personal details, attach it, and ask what it means and what to do
questions.explain: A photo plus a clear question gets a useful answer, and covering sensitive details protects your privacy. You should still check important numbers and deadlines against the original.

questions.q: You want AI to create an image for a printed flyer that shows your event's name. What should you do?
options: Ask for the exact wording inside the image and use whatever comes back
Describe only the subject and let the AI choose everything else
Describe the subject, style, mood and use, then add the text yourself
Base it on a photo of a real person so the flyer looks more authentic
questions.explain: Describe four things: subject, style, composition and mood, and use. Image generators can still struggle with exact wording, so add any text yourself in a design or document app.
